description: Delete then reinsert of one key with a longer value: Dr row 8 is deleted, then ID 8 is inserted again with A 80 and a 60-character Vt. Asks whether the longer row can reuse the freed space. Dr: 20 small rows (ID Long key, A Long, Vt Text(60) 'original text of row <ID>'), ID 1..20. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
